newsitem.title: USA: Motorola files suit vs U.S Robotics.
newsitem.headline: Motorola files suit vs U.S Robotics.

text.p: Motorola Inc said on Thursday it had filed a complaint against U.S. Robotics Corp for allegedly infringing on a number of its patents for high-speed modem technology.
Some of the patents may apply to next-generation 56-kilobit modem technology, Motorola said.

Skokie, Illinois-based U.S. Robotics is planning to ship modems in the next few days that allow users to download information from the Internet at a rate of 56 kilobits per second over ordinary, analog telephone lines, the company said.
Schaumburg, Illinois-based Motorola said the lawsuit came after several years of negotiations.

"Motorola actively invests in new technology for worldwide standards and is committed to making that technology available on a fair, reasonable and non-discriminatory basis," Randy Battat, vice president of Motorola's Information Systems Group, said in a news release. "At the same time, the company will vigorously defend its intellectual property and its right to fair compensation for the use of that property."
A U.S. Robotics spokeswoman said the company had yet to see the lawsuit and could not immediately coment.
